image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors on a grassy lawn wearing academic regalia. The person on the left wears a black gown with pink velvet panels and a doctoral tam, holding a scroll. The person on the right wears a blue gown with three black velvet bars on the sleeves and a white hood. Both figures exhibit significant anatomical anomalies, particularly in the lower limbs and feet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the upper bodies show the correct silhouette, the garments fail to drape correctly to the ankles due to severe structural collapse in the lower legs/feet area, breaking the continuous rectangular flow.
The upper torso of both gowns maintains bilateral symmetry and shows the characteristic front opening panels.
The fabric successfully obscures the torso and arm contours, appearing voluminous as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive wide, bell-shaped sleeves are clearly visible and hang appropriately past the wrists/hands.
The vertical panels (pink for the left figure, blue/black for the right) are distinct and correctly positioned.

The figure on the right appears to be barefoot with no visible trousers or shoes, violating the 'formal attire' context. The figure on the left has strange white boot-like structures that do not resemble standard formal wear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears consistent with heavy matte fabric, showing appropriate folds and lack of high-gloss reflection.
The material properties match the description of a smooth, non-reflective finish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve extensions are prominent and drape correctly relative to the arms.

artifact_observations.location: Lower legs and feet of both subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure of anatomy. The subject on the right has bare, malformed feet that seem to merge with the grass. The subject on the left has white, tube-like structures for legs/boots that lack defined feet or ankles, appearing to float or melt into the ground.
The fingers appear to merge with the white scroll object, lacking clear separation between skin and paper.

artifact_observations.location: Face of the subject on the left
artifact_observations.reasoning: The facial features are slightly smeared and lack sharp definition, typical of AI-generated portraits at this resolution.
The lines of the building in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective.

Boundary integrity between gown hem and ground
